question: The architectural feature of the true arch and dome in India was first introduced by the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi Sultanate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **true arch and dome** were first introduced in India by the **Delhi Sultanate**, marking a significant shift in architectural practices.
 
• The **Delhi Sultanate** (1206–1526 CE) brought Persian and Central Asian architectural styles to India.
 
• The introduction of the **true arch** (keystone-based) and dome replaced the corbelled or trabeate arches that were common in pre-Islamic Indian architecture.
 
• Examples of this style include the **Qutub Minar complex** and the **Alai Darwaza**, which reflect the influence of Islamic architecture.
